book.name: Hipru
book.title: Hipru Honi Tombaiva Geinna Hiprunindmba, Sesoava Ishovna Ombolnashara.

content: Pioa Indakonda Nesmos Avramana Velohra Pivmoa.
Yimba Kristusnindva, yeoa nesmos avramana vevm henom henom mongawa pendarinimsna Kristusnind.
Ningvm, deisumbisuv velm ilorinim pevna deuvram. Monglava indhanamba doa vina honamba, deisumbisuv vena ovsongolnindmba maim titnam.

Manam yimba numbulvav, nomba temba buimerava aevulvpa. Nengewuvunvm hemoa, os ovra, kava kav aevulv buimerava mongawulm. Ninginvm hem nom, ungund ten indkokla vewol vivm, os ovra, kamba eva osta indkokla vewol vivta.
Onganungmoa longong vrivra indkumbioa. Tlal ongal hevna evrowolalmoa, hengava manam emuksawoksava evevav. Sesoava sesm si vinvav hindmba, nomba temba iaindavpa ongariskuirava.
Pevna almoa beswonam sungiavhoapro, dimba muemb hlalmba. Wo nona yemoa wohkanandhawol vevra, ten pev noi wulavm. Sesoava os ona,

content.text: Kava si yemba nombolvramoa, kava si yemba mai vevramoa. Lo 31:6

content: Wo pivva osva ningv, tanam, wo uvra,

content.text: Kava si pemba vivramoa, manara noinda mendekli kamba kolvravra, indhanamba mana vemava kamba vinivrava. Buk Song 118:6

content: Ninginvm pevna mundilm mendeklim. Himba numhowol vivna yemba Sesoana moana. Ninginvm, es himba avna, wo es hemba sihavna, wo hena undnahonam alm ninginvrava, os ao yeoa evata.
Yesus Kristusva eva osta luhunv pimba, om, detim, wo osangas yunalm.

Manam yimba nihva wuleihinvav indhanamba, yemba numhowolalmba monakoklaramba. Yenaoa indoa wohlovahinvra keknamangas, Sesoana wavranangas, innena wevsamba hlalmba owai. Snamba engalmba lohohmomba, owainonoa, mongomba indhanarinimba kolvravavmoa.

Pinamba luhunv altasengmsna, memba Yesus hev. Wo heva os Yutanindna sembayang andranindva, himba nomba andra vevpa no lair sembayangduvmerava, himba nevavmoa nominiva hevpa. Memba olhmomba olhinv pimba, osm Kristusva hevm wuraohna, dahalmba pina indkoklaram. Wo honi henga wohkuvhueinna Yutanindna tatasowamba.

Yimba nonora av, kuwul sembayang andranindna tata tovolva longaisiha vev domba meramba kuloholnonoa vuheramba. Wo di himba dembhamnav Sesoamba, indhanamba kilumb shuawolalmba. Wo heva os nomba nihilva di ambara wohweisumbololowov ehalla.
Wo eva Yesusva os wukleihinata amballa kotara Yerusalemrava. Hemba dahana, hevtindim Sesoalmangas alm hevna tovolnanam.
Wo noinda osva eva pioa hem patvlohmanara elsus, loum vramnalm henam. Pioa eva os vralohrata mongawatovna, Yesus ten vranam.
Manara, huiva petharava pinamba luhunvmoa, yunalmba dihelalmba kotava. Heva os pimba aslalv kotamba nomba, osmba sewonamba noi si pimba yunalmba wulaevvav.
Wo noinda osva elsusoa pioa Sesoam okuluvmona velohra. Memba pivna okolal phunv pivna moarini, ten piv sevra ovrivm hem, os Yesusva mendekli lohv. Memba pina Kristusnindna tatasowamsnamba luhunv.
Manam yimba maivithivav, beswonamba vinilmba mongnindmba. Wo wonamong vevm hemoa, yimba nomba iaevulvrava. Hona wevsara Sesoava indk vethav.

Wohengalvohmana vevm pevna mundil mendeklimoa, wo ambo vinvm hena keusingi taivwonam. Hona indhanamba novna vewol viv yemba, noinda hena andrava luhunv, yena indmba novna vewol vinilmba. Wo Sesoava si henamba lesvhoawol vinvav. Wohhilwulvm hemoa, osm himba wohvivra hona andrava indwonam, duuswonamba owai. Si yemba owai honamba kolvrowol vevavmoa, yimba kinmba hemba pelhola ovunvrava.
Wohvewuvunvm sembayangnaoa kamoa. Kava ningv, osva tanam nomba manam manam, memba kavpa vildavpa, manara, kava elsusm manam manam vilangalmangas besalm viv.
Wo kava yemba keknam ishunv, os sembayangnaoa ambo lotholohvra, osm Sesoava si henga wolaihaprinvav kamba yemba lilnam.

Kava sembayang vev, osm Sesoa si yemba vinvav, osm yimba wevsabesalna avra, wo yimba vivra, nomba osva himba temba undva vrevpa. Sesoava noi, pim ten sandhavm, indwonam alm, himba noi, ten wolaihaphonam pokamarini pina mendeklim Yesus Kristusm, mendekli sipsipna kekalvhonindrini. Sesoava wolaihaphona hemba, noinda tovolva hevna dahallinira. Henamba tovolva pinamba novmba wuleihinna, osm Sesoana moamba tanam, nom Sesoa ten wonvenam hevtindim. Wo hona moamba si mueisowa vevavmoa yunalm, wohloholm, nonapopolm alm beswonam. Kava sembayang vev, osm Sesoava Kristusnashara si vinvav pimba, noindava himba indk vethavpa. Wo eva Yesus Kristusnanamba himba pimba indkumbimba daswolvav no wevsana, hev ten und vevm, wo elsusva pivva hemba okuluvmona vevra. Tanamta.
Eunilmoa.
Seh, kava yemba os ninginv, keknam beswonam hillivm hona moam, men kav novol vinvm yem, suwenamendna vewol ovolm. Wo heva os honamba memba tombaiva hutemothol, mani tokolma.
Kava yemba osm vinv, yeoa nonora aevulvm, osoa pina boasalalva Timotiva doa pholahaphona buiriniva. Wo himba protava lelnamba kaindamba, kava si osva mongawulm epravav hei, yemba nongalalmba.
Ishunu kana sehmoaoa indkumbim kuwulm mundilm pevnam, eva indkumbim Sesoatindim. Eva osoa vei, noi Romnind Kristusnind himba yemba piembinv sehmoa.
Sesoaoa yemoa indkumbimoa wavra vewol vevra. Doata.
